name: Chidi Okonkwo
psychographics: Focuses on reliability and 'making sure the money goes far'; avoids unnecessary tech friction, prefers face-to-face transactions.
current_solutions: Relies on cash for most purchases; uses OPay for airtime top-ups and occasional motorcycle fuel payments, but still visits market stalls for food and supplies.
frustration: His Keke NAPPA (tricycle) broke down on Third Mainland Bridge at 10:30 AM; the mechanic asked for ₦5,000 for a part he could have bought for ₦2,000 at a market, and Chidi had to wait 3 hours because he didn't have the exact cash on hand.
decision_style: Asks neighbors and fellow traders for recommendations; rarely buys anything new without a referral from someone he trusts implicitly.
voice: Formal yet grounded in Pidgin English; uses proverbs like 'naija no balance' when describing hardship, speaks in longer, measured sentences about money.
